details.method: Use explicit UTF-8 when reading/writing repository source, inspect non-ASCII codepoint changes against the actual base, and encode security-sensitive expected aliases independently as numeric codepoints in tests.
details.when: Editing UTF-8 source under a Windows locale that can decode UTF-8 byte pairs as valid different characters; implementation and tests may share the same faulty edit pipeline.
details.counterexample: A passing test that transcodes its expected string along with the implementation can conceal the same regression. Numeric codepoint probes do not prove arbitrary code or binary asset encoding correct.
details.trial_plan: In an isolated in-memory function, deliberately decode original UTF-8 superscript bytes as GBK; confirm mirrored transcoded literal assertions can pass while numeric U+00B9/U+00B2/U+00B3 probes detect failure. Confirm original UTF-8 function rejects those reserved aliases and permits unrelated Chinese suffixes. Do not mutate production source for the trial.
